title: 第1312章 陈胜苏醒第1311章 虚天殿遗址
content_zh:
陈平踏入漩涡中央黑洞的瞬间，一股强大的吸力包裹住他的全身。
吸力不是从单一方向来的，而是从四面八方同时挤压拉扯，像是要把他撕成碎片。
体内的婴元自动运转，在体表形成一层淡青色的护体灵光，将这股撕扯力隔绝在外。
眼前的黑暗持续了三息时间。
三息之后，脚底踩到了实物。
触感坚硬平整，是石板地面。
陈平睁开眼，发现自己站在一片开阔的平台上。
平台由大块青石铺成，每块青石边长超过一丈，表面平整，缝隙处生长着干枯的苔藓。
平台前方是一片广袤的天地。
头顶是灰蒙蒙的天空，没有太阳，没有云层，只有一层暗沉的光均匀地铺满整个空间。
远处有山峦起伏，山上覆盖着枯死的树木，树干扭曲，枝桠光秃，没有一片叶子。
山脚下有干涸的河床，河床里没有水，只有灰白色的碎石和枯骨。
空气中没有风，但有一股陈旧的气味，像打开了一口封了千年的棺材。
这不是遗址。
遗址是残垣断壁，是倒塌的建筑，是风化的碑文。
眼前这片天地却是完整的，有山有水有天空，自成一体。
这是一个完整的小世界！
陈平站在平台边缘，目光扫过这片灰蒙蒙的天地，心里涌出的第一个念头是：
韩老鬼这次下了血本，竟然用一个小世界来当诱饵。
在他身后，漩涡的入口还在运转，不断有修士从里面被甩出来。

每个进来的人都在第一时间打量四周，目光中带着戒备和期待。
云歌从漩涡中走出，脚步轻盈地落在陈平身旁。
她站定之后，目光也在四周扫了一圈，眉头微微皱起，鼻翼轻轻翕动，在嗅空气中的气味。
周围的修士们没有在平台上停留。
他们三五成群，朝着四面八方散去，很快消失在山峦之间。
每个人选择的方向都不同，但从他们的表情和动作来看，都很笃定。
陈平知道他们为什么笃定。
在坊市和酒楼里，他听到了很多关于韩道人的传闻。
其中流传最广的一个版本是：
韩道人之所以能修炼得这么快，能在百年内从元婴初期冲到半步化神，是因为他在虚天殿遗址中得到了逆天机缘。
虚天殿遗址是他的发迹之地，是他气运爆发的起点……
想都不用想……
这个传闻是韩道人自己编造的。
一个励志故事，一个用来解释他修为暴涨的合理理由。
有了他这个人形例子摆在面前，其他修士对虚天殿遗址的价值深信不疑。
能让资质平平的修士，在百年内冲击化神的机缘，谁都想要。
陈平当然不会信。
他知晓韩道人的修为暴涨，不是因为虚天殿遗址。
但他不得不承认，韩道人这套编造出来的故事确实好用。
看看周围那些修士发亮的眼神就知道了，他们是真的相信自己能在这里找到逆天机缘。

"师尊。"
云歌的声音在旁边响起，语调有些异样。
陈平偏头看她。
content_en:
The moment Chen Ping stepped into the black hole in the center of the vortex, a strong suction force enveloped his whole body.
The suction force didn't come from a single direction, but squeezed and pulled from all directions at the same time, as if to tear him into pieces.
The Ying Yuan in the body operates automatically, forming a layer of light cyan body-protecting spiritual light on the body surface, isolating this tearing force from the outside.
The darkness in front of him lasted for three breaths.
After three breaths, the soles of my feet stepped on something real.
It feels hard and flat, like a slate floor.
Chen Ping opened his eyes and found himself standing on an open platform.
The platform is paved with large pieces of bluestone, each of which is more than a foot long on a side. The surface is flat, with dry moss growing in the gaps.
In front of the platform is a vast world.
There was a gray sky above, no sun, no clouds, only a layer of dull light that spread evenly across the entire space.
There are rolling hills in the distance, covered with dead trees, with twisted trunks, bare branches, and no leaves.
There is a dry river bed at the foot of the mountain. There is no water in the river bed, only gray-white gravel and dead bones.
There was no wind in the air, but there was an old smell, like opening a coffin that had been sealed for thousands of years.
This is not a ruins.
The ruins are ruins, collapsed buildings and weathered inscriptions.
The world in front of us is complete, with mountains, water and sky, forming a self-contained whole.
It's a whole little world!
Chen Ping stood on the edge of the platform, his eyes scanning the gray world, and the first thought that came to his mind was:
Old Ghost Han spent a lot of money this time and actually used a small world as bait.
Behind him, the entrance to the vortex was still spinning, and monks were constantly being thrown out of it.
Everyone who came in looked around for the first time, with alertness and expectation in their eyes.
Yun Ge walked out of the whirlpool and landed next to Chen Ping with light steps.
After she stood still, she glanced around, her brows slightly wrinkled, her nose twitching slightly, sniffing the smell in the air.
The surrounding monks did not stop on the platform.
They formed small groups and dispersed in all directions, quickly disappearing among the mountains.
Everyone chose a different direction, but judging from their expressions and actions, they were all determined.
Chen Ping knew why they were determined.
In the market and restaurants, he heard a lot of rumors about Taoist Han.
One of the most widely circulated versions is:
The reason why Taoist Han was able to practice so quickly, from the early stage of Nascent Soul to half-step into a god within a hundred years, was because he got a heaven-defying opportunity at the ruins of the Xutian Palace.
The ruins of Xutian Palace are the place where he made his fortune and the starting point of his luck...
No need to think about it…
This rumor was fabricated by Han Daoren himself.
An inspirational story, a reasonable reason to explain his skyrocketing cultivation.
With his humanoid example in front of them, the other monks were convinced of the value of the Xutian Palace ruins.
Everyone wants the opportunity that allows a monk with mediocre qualifications to become a god within a hundred years.
Of course Chen Ping wouldn't believe it.
He knew that Taoist Han's cultivation level had skyrocketed, not because of the Xutian Palace ruins.
But he had to admit that Han Daoren's fabricated story was really useful.
Just look at the shining eyes of the monks around you and you will know that they really believe that they can find a heaven-defying opportunity here.
"Master."
Yun Ge's voice sounded nearby, with a strange tone.
Chen Ping tilted his head to look at her.
